trainable: pretrained RPN + ROI heads; frozen MobileNet/FPN backbone and BN
head: background/ball, transferred COCO37 and background0 weights
validation_sample: every8th validation frame (20frames), identical for all configurations; no TEST inference
selection: maximum validation F1 at IoU0.25, confidence grid0.05,0.1,0.2,0.35,0.5; ties favor precision and full-frame lower cost
test: locked model and operating point evaluated once; original matched frame list for all ablations
ground_plane: automatic ground contact is a conservative heuristic, not true3D; otherwise image-only
